verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes its core commerce modules and framework as official open-source packages on npm, and it maintains complete OpenAPI 3.0 specs for the Store and Admin APIs that developers could use to generate or validate clients. That lets developers build against official, first-party building blocks. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes an official client SDK, such as a JS/TS SDK for storefronts or the admin API. A probe also found no OpenAPI spec served at standard docs paths. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official client SDK (languages, install, usage), SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
